title: Greg Eghigian researching his UFO history book at the archive

tellings.quote: he spent a couple of weeks here uh

plain: A historian named Greg Eghigian spent a couple of weeks at a large UFO archive in Sweden while researching his book on the history of UFOs. That is according to a Swedish UFO researcher named Clas Svahn, who keeps the archive and hosted him there. Svahn mentions it to show that serious scholars come to use the collection.
